$description:
AUTHORED — the fluid scale. min/max rem pairs; build/generate-fluid.mjs runs each through fluidAxis (the XY clamp core) into a clamp() custom property. Adapted faithfully from the operator's foundry fluid sources (source/fluid/*.fluid.ts). Read by the generator, not by Style Dictionary directly (it sits outside tokens/src/, like hues.json).

Every value here interpolates: min at the small viewport corner, max at the large one, tracking BOTH width and height. Names match what the app/shell consume (--sp-*, --fs-*, --r-*).

type.$description: Fluid type ramp → --fs-*. Leading companions are static (not fluid) and ride along.

shell.$description: Shell geometry → --topbar-height, --bottombar-height, --rail-*, --panel-width, --dock-lip, --tap-min. Ported byte-identical from the foundry shell.fluid.ts clamps (primitives.css). The shell components read these directly.

control.$description: Control geometry → --ctl-*. Ported from the foundry control.fluid.ts clamps. Feeds the app @theme inline `--spacing-ctl-* → var(--ctl-*)` so `size-ctl-icon`, `min-w-ctl-btn` etc. resolve.
